summary: Data-loss fixes from the T3 audit. Diff cards offer Reject only for files this chat's own edit tools wrote (others show 'changed outside this chat's edit tools'), never for a binary file or a side git could not read; a session folder inside a repository gets paths relative to it and only its own files; a steer or queued send keeps the running turn's baseline and a queued turn starts from the previous turn's end tree; the baseline is stored in SQLite and restored when the chat starts after a restart. OpenCode refuses a plain send while busy instead of storing it as sent. A queued message that never ran (stop, crash, restart) becomes an error row that keeps its text. A Claude resume retry sends the unanswered messages again. Compatibility: Additive only: optional noRevert on file.edited and stored diff cards, optional writtenPaths on tool.completed, and a new turn.dequeued reason use ('dropped') that older clients already treat as a plain dequeue. Older backends send no noRevert, so their cards keep Reject as before. The two new tables are created with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS.

notExercised: No live agent run: tool attribution is tested against each adapter's event shape, not a real Claude, Codex or OpenCode session. OpenCode's completed edit update is assumed to carry kind 'edit'; if it does not, those cards show without Reject (the safe side).
The restart restore was not exercised by killing a running app; it is tested at the tracker and the SQLite store.
Phones show diff cards without Reject already, so they need no noRevert handling.
